name: השלמה לריבוע ופתרון משוואה ריבועית עם שורשים שלמים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Give the following quadratic in completed square form i.e. in the form \(\left( x+a \right)^2+b.\)
\[ {{CT:0}} \]
[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt2]]
Solve the quadratic equation \({{CT:0}}=0\). Give your answer as a set \(\left(\mbox e.g.\ \left\{x_1 , x_2\right\} \right)\):
[[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt1]]
generalfeedback:
When solving a more complicated quadratic a better option, than factorising, is completing the square (The method by which we remove the {{CT:1}} term). The general rule is:
\[ ax^2+bx+c = a\left(x^2+\frac{b}{a}x+\frac{c}{a}x \right) = a\left(\left(x+\frac{b}{2a} \right)^2-\frac{b^2}{4a^2}+\frac{c}{a} = a\left(x+\frac{b}{2a} \right)^2-\frac{b^2}{4a}+c \right). \]
Once you have removed the \(x\) term you can rearrange the formula to find \((x+\frac{b}{2a})^2\). Then you simply need to square root and rearrange to find \(x\). In this example: \[ {{CT:2}} = 0, \] we extract the {{CT:3}} coefficient, \({{CT:4}}\): \[ {{CT:5}} = 0. \] Then we complete the square: \[ {{CT:2}} = 0. \] Rearranging gives: \[ {{CT:6}} = {{CT:7}}. \] Square root (remember to take plus and minus): \[ {{CT:8}} = \pm {{CT:9}}. \] Finally: \[ {{CT:10}} = {{CT:11}} \pm {{CT:9}}. \] Therefeore, our solution set is: \[ {{CT:12}} \]
